concerns.text: FR‑008 (halt the analysis if core constructs are missing) has no implementing task; the existing tasks (T080‑T082) handle exclusion logging and fail‑loud file errors but do not check for the presence of `discount_rate_k`, `procrastination_score`, and `wm_*` columns and abort the pipeline if any are absent.
FR‑010 (runtime ≤ 6 h and memory ≤ 7 GB) is only recorded by T102 (resource‑usage logging) but there is no task that enforces the limits or fails the pipeline when they are exceeded.

SC‑002 (bootstrap CI must not include zero when the primary effect is significant) is not verified; T071 generates the CI but no subsequent task checks whether the interval crosses zero and flags a failure.

SC‑004 (instability flag if > 50 % of sensitivity‑sweep thresholds yield a CI crossing zero) is absent; the sensitivity sweep tasks produce p‑values but do not evaluate the 50 % instability condition or record it in the results JSON.
SC‑005 (enforce the 6‑hour runtime and 7 GB memory caps) is not covered; T102 only records usage without any enforcement step.

The plan’s contracts (`contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` and `contracts/output.schema.yaml`) are never generated or validated by any task; there is no task that creates, tests, or updates these schema files.
A stale reference to a non‑existent task ID `T032` appears in the FR‑010 note ("(see T032)") but no task T032 is defined in this file.
